audit.why: EVEN 6/10 with Garen owning levels 1-5 and Nautilus taking over at 2+ items matches the 41.67% win rate and the content layer's arc.

audit.why: The two directions must not contradict. Garen's Courage tenacity and shield blunt the follow-up to Depth Charge, so the row belongs to Garen with only 2+ items conceded to Nautilus.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never names Decisive Strike, Judgment, Perseverance or Demacian Justice, and describes Courage only as 'damage reduction' with no cooldown.
audit.why: Riot text: Courage grants a shield and tenacity then lesser damage reduction, 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s. Decisive Strike is a 8s move-speed burst that breaks slows and silences on the empowered strike, and it carries the autoReset flag — per the missing-interactions file the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Courage's shield is also the burst-absorber to bait before committing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real names and the 22s / 8s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Trade when Courage is down' with no duration.
audit.why: 22s at rank 1 is the longest punishable window Garen has in lane; Decisive Strike returns every 8s so it cannot be the tracked timer.
audit.corrected: Both numbers stated in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: My R is an undodgeable knock-up his Q-silence can't cancel mid-flight, so the level-6 all-in is genuinely a coin-flip on his Q timer.
edits.after: My R is an undodgeable knock-up Decisive Strike can't cancel mid-flight, but Courage's tenacity and shield still edge the level-6 all-in.

edits.before: That is Garen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
